about: Jet Knitwears Ltd is a Kanpur-based branded innerwear and casual-wear manufacturer. Incorporated on April 2, 1996, to take over the erstwhile partnership business whose hosiery roots date to 1969; brands include Lycot Australia, Jet, Jet Eco, Fresh-Long, Boski and Take-off. [1]
